notes:
ちゃんと is a colloquial adverb meaning "properly" or "correctly." Very common in everyday speech.

USAGE:
1. Properly, correctly (doing something the right way)
2. Reliably, without fail (dependably)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ちゃんと⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat properly
- ちゃんと⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen properly
- ちゃんと⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come without fail
- ちゃんと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: proper, decent (modifies nouns)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧: properly, neatly (slightly more formal)
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧: firmly, thoroughly
- ⟦きっちり→きっちり：10310_kicchiri⟧: precisely, exactly

REGISTER:
Colloquial. Often used by parents speaking to children, but common among all ages in casual speech.

EXAMPLE CONTEXTS:
- ちゃんと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: proper clothes
- ちゃんと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: a proper job
- ちゃんと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧: a responsible adult
